inventory.sourceFigureDescription: The printed STRAIN | TOXIN AND MECHANISM | PRESENTATION table: EIEC (invasive, like Shigella), ETEC (heat-labile + heat-stable enterotoxins, watery traveler's diarrhea), EPEC (no toxin; adheres, flattens villi, prevents absorption; children), EHEC (O157:H7; undercooked meat, raw leafy vegetables; does not ferment sorbitol; Shiga toxin causes the hemolytic-uremic syndrome triad; dysentery from toxin alone). Pure vector.
